ABOUT MERCOR



Mercor’s mission is to organize human intelligence for the AI economy. We build the infrastructure that enables frontier AI labs and enterprises to train, evaluate, and improve AI on real-world professional work. More than five million experts have joined our network, and we pay out over $5 million daily for their knowledge and expertise.

We built our training and evaluation infrastructure alongside the world’s leading AI labs. Now, we’re bringing those capabilities to enterprises across industries, enabling them to train, evaluate, and improve AI using their own expertise and standards. Our APEX benchmarks measure how AI performs on economically valuable work, while our enterprise evaluations and post-training capabilities turn those insights into measurable improvements across real-world workflows.

Our work sits at the intersection of frontier AI, human expertise, and real-world application. We’re solving problems few companies have encountered, with the opportunity to influence what the world’s most advanced AI systems become capable of doing. We’re looking for people who bring different perspectives, take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and hold themselves to an exceptionally high standard. You’ll have the opportunity to do consequential work alongside talented colleagues who challenge one another, collaborate openly, and share a commitment to excellence.

Mercor is profitable and recently raised a $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation. We work in person five days a week in San Francisco, New York, and London.



About the Role

As a Software Engineer, Applied AI on Mercor's Enterprise team, you'll operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer success. Engineers on this team are builders first, embedding directly with enterprise clients to design and implement technical solutions that unlock the full value of Mercor's platform while applying strong systems and product thinking where it matters. The work spans everything from architecting integrations and writing production-grade code to deploying scalable solutions in production environments, always tied closely to measurable business outcomes. You'll collaborate with customer stakeholders and internal teams to deliver systems that directly shape how AI-powered human intelligence integrates into complex enterprises.

You will:

 - Embed with enterprise customers to understand technical requirements and business goals.

 - Architect and implement custom integrations, APIs, and workflows on top of Mercor’s platform.

 - Deploy scalable solutions in client environments and drive successful launches and expansions.

 - Build internal tools and reusable components that accelerate future deployments.

 - Translate ambiguous enterprise needs into clear technical plans and shipped systems.

What We’re Looking For

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals in at least one modern language (Python, Go, Rust, etc.).

 - Experience building and deploying production systems in cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure).

 - Comfort working directly with customers and explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

 - High ownership mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity and operate autonomously in high-stakes environments.

Why Mercor

 - Impact: Your work defines how leading enterprises deploy AI-powered human intelligence systems.

 - Learning: Gain deep exposure to real-world applications of AI across industries and use cases.

 - Growth: Work across engineering and product with fast paths to ownership.

Benefits

 - Bi-annual performance bonus structure

 - Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

 - Up to $15k Relocation bonus

 - $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

 - $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

 - Free Equinox membership

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

 - Health, Dental, Vision insurance

As a Fraud Engineer at Mercor, you'll help build the systems that protect the integrity of our platform at scale. You'll work on high-impact problems across identity verification, abuse prevention, and project-level fraud, partnering closely with product and engineering to understand where risk exists, quantify it, and turn that understanding into durable systems and workflows.

This role is ideal for someone who has seen fraud problems firsthand and can translate that experience into practical roadmaps, strong technical judgment, and fast-moving execution. You will:

 - Own and build fraud detection and prevention systems across multiple fraud surfaces, including identity and platform abuse.

 - Partner closely with product and engineering to define a fraud roadmap, prioritize the highest-leverage problems, and ship defenses quickly.

 - Design and implement tools, workflows, and backend systems that detect suspicious behavior and reduce fraudulent activity.

 - Establish clearer visibility into fraud patterns, operational risk, and the effectiveness of prevention systems over time.

 - Work across ambiguous, fast-moving problem spaces and independently drive large scopes of work on a lean team.

What We're Looking For

 - 2+ years of experience in software engineering.

 - Preferred: Experience working on fraud or abuse prevention, with a strong understanding of how to translate patterns and threats into product and engineering roadmaps.

 - Ability to operate autonomously and take ownership over large, ambiguous problem areas.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals and comfort building production systems.

 - A practical, high-judgment approach to balancing speed, security, and user experience.

 - Impact: Your work will directly protect the integrity of Mercor's platform and the systems that power the future of AI work.
